Amanda, saw Stampli closed the $61M Blackstone round and just launched Deep Finance.

Growing the install base that fast usually means more expansion accounts in play than your team can cover, and that is where renewal and upsell pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Stampli off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Amanda, quick follow-up for Stampli.

With a fresh raise and Deep Finance to cross-sell, the install-base number climbs faster than headcount can, and most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it. The gap surfaces late, when saving the quarter is already a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your install-base team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Amanda, last bit of proof for Stampli.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Stampli's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth fintech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
